transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I, um... I guess I'm here because... people have been noticing things about me. Like, I guess I've been moving really slow lately. Like I'm underwater or something. Taking a long time to just... get out of a chair, or even answer when someone talks to me. 

And then other times, I just... I can't stop pacing around my apartment. Just walking back and forth, rubbing my hands together. Like I'm trying to shake off a bad call at work or something. It's just... yeah. That's what's been happening.
Have you noticed that you're not enjoying things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you normally like doing?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... I used to do a few things. Sketching... keeping notes on coffee. Going for hikes on the weekends. They used to make me feel... like myself, I guess. 

But lately... I don't know. I'll open the notebook, or lace up my boots, and... I just feel nothing pulling me toward it. So I just... haven't been doing much.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I mean... I guess so. It's hard to say if it's every day, but... yeah, mostly. Just sort of... heavy, I guess. I don't really know how else to describe it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I don't really have an appetite lately. Most days I don't even remember to eat until, like, the afternoon. And even then... I just grab some toast or maybe cereal. Cooking just... feels like too much effort right now. 

And... yeah, my jeans are definitely fitting a lot looser than they were. So I guess I've lost some weight.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven't done much physically?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I'm not really doing much to get tired from, so... I guess my energy is fine. Just... normal, I think.
Can you tell me more about the times when you feel slowed down or when you can't stop pacing? How often does this happen, and does it interfere with your daily life?

Um... well, people can actually see it, I guess. That's kind of why I came in. Sometimes I just... move like I'm underwater. Like it takes me forever to answer someone, or even just to get out of a chair. 

And then... other times, I just end up pacing my apartment. Just walking around, rubbing my hands together... sort of like I'm trying to shake off a bad call at work. I don't know. It just happens sometimes.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or that you're failing others, even when you haven't done anything wrong?

I mean... maybe a little. I just... I get stuck on things sometimes. Like at work, or my contract jobs. Just small mistakes. 

I'll just... keep replaying them in my head. Like if I send one slow reply, I start thinking I completely let everyone down... that I probably deserve to be fired over it. So... yeah. I don't know.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or if you'd be better off not being here?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think about stuff like that. Just... no.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these symptoms been going on for at least two years, or are they more recent?
Um... yeah, it's been over two years. Maybe... two years and three months, I think. It started right after... um... after I got fired from my old customer support job. So... yeah. Since then.
Have you noticed that it's been harder to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions lately?
Um... no. I don't think so. I can focus fine, mostly. I just... do my work. I haven't really noticed a problem with that.
